TiO2-veter core–shell nanoparticles have higher photocatalytic activity than pure TiO2 nanoparticles because of their higher specific surface area and pore volume, and lower crystallinity.
TiO2–vetiver core–shell nano particles have better photocatalytic activity than the TiO2 nano particles because of their unique morphology.

the preparation of TiO2-veter composite nanoparticles by a sol-gel method followed by calcination at 450°C.
the synthesis of TiO2–vetiver core–shell nanoparticles and their application in the degradation of methylene blue dye under UV–A irradiation.
the development of a new class of TiO2-veter multifunctional nano particles for the photocatalytic degradation of organic dyes.
